title: Premium-state asymmetry between short (front) and mid (back) vol ETP buckets

blindness_declaration.law: D1 outcome-blind proposal: no outcome measurement, no returns conditional on states, no expectancies, no signal arithmetic on prices or indices beyond structural facts already committed in P0/P1/P2 artifacts. Every numeric leaf below is a committed structural fact cited from a sha256-pinned P0/P1/P2 artifact and appears only under committed_citations, representation_identity or feasibility_citation.
blindness_declaration.parameters_symbolic_until: D2/S (frozen before any scored number is seen; no threshold may move after any scored number)

mechanism.narrative: Two different forced participants live on the two segments of the vol curve. The front segment (the SHORT-bucket legs, whose committed path formula tracks the near-term spread) carries the roll-payment flow of maturity-hedgers and crowded premium sellers; the mid segment (the MID-bucket legs, whose committed path formula tracks the multi-month spread) carries longer-dated institutional protection and maturity-seeking hedgers. The premium state measured on the short-leg proxy can therefore disagree with the mid-curve state for extended intervals. When the two segments' states diverge persistently, exactly one participant class is currently FORCED (the one whose segment's state is extreme) while the other segment still prices choice; the asymmetry state names the forced side.
mechanism.forced_participant: Whichever segment's premium state is extreme: on a short-segment extreme it is the maturity-hedger / crowded-seller complex of the front bucket, forced to roll or unwind at the front; on a mid-segment extreme it is the institutional protection buyer of the mid bucket, forced to keep paying for dated protection. The asymmetry state itself is what identifies WHICH side is forced, session by session.
mechanism.late_participant: Rotation flow between short and mid ETPs that chases the divergence only after it is public -- ETP rotation lags the state divergence, arriving after the forced side has already been identified by the curve, which is the late-entrant footprint this proposal declares.
mechanism.claim_declared_blind: A persistent asymmetry between the short-leg premium state (the P2-declared implied-vs-implied-complex proxy) and the mid-curve premium-state extension identifies which segment's forced flow is being paid; whether conditioning the two ETP buckets on that asymmetry survives the full measured cost ladder is exactly what D2 measures. Nothing is measured now.
mechanism.economic_magnitude_honesty: Declared honestly: the P2 worst-case round-trip cost ceilings at the primary stress tier (cited under feasibility_citation) are on the order of two thousand basis points on the SHORT-bucket legs and roughly fifteen hundred on the MID-bucket legs. A two-bucket rotation rule pays costs on both sides of the asymmetry; only large, persistent, one-sided asymmetry states can plausibly clear such bounds, and the family dies cheap if the asymmetry is small or flickering.

structural_limitation_p2_gate_c8_verbati: STRUCTURAL LIMITATION (declared, C8): the realized proxy is the realized volatility of the event-adjusted VXX close.  An ETP-leg realized vol is NOT S&P 500 realized vol -- it is implied-complex realized vol: a leveraged, fee-bearing VIX-futures-complex instrument whose realized path embeds roll and decay.  The implied-vs-realized state computed from it is an implied-vs-implied-complex proxy, never the classic implied-vs-spot-realized variance risk premium.
structural_limitation_consequence: The frozen P2 declaration builds the proxy on the SHORT leg (event-adjusted VXX close); the mid-bucket arm of this proposal extends the SAME declared proxy family symbolically to the mid leg's own event-adjusted close, to be frozen at D2/S BEFORE any scored number. Every conclusion is an implied-vs-implied-complex statement; any wording as the classic spot variance risk premium is invalid-null (identity violation). The limitation travels with every downstream artifact of this proposal.

why_information_differs.v16_close_displace_fade: the shadow fades a first-difference displacement of one instrument's close; this proposal's state is a BETWEEN-SEGMENT asymmetry of two implied-vs-implied-complex spread states -- a relative variance-state object across curve segments, not a price displacement of any single instrument. D2 tests the claim at the frozen ancestry margin.
why_information_differs.v17_oi_level: the shadow is a derivative open-interest LEVEL form; the frozen consumption set contains no options chain and no open-interest series (EODHD family-2 explicitly not entitled), so no OI re-clock is possible. D2 tests the claim by ancestry pooling.
why_information_differs.dvol_shock: the shadow is a realized derivative-shock form on a different asset complex; this proposal's realized sides are trailing realized-volatility proxies of event-adjusted ETP closes inside the frozen consumption set. The specific risk that roll/decay contamination makes the asymmetry behave like a disguised ETP shock form is NAMED and pooled at D2, not assumed away.
why_information_differs.momentum_63s: the shadow is long-horizon single-series price momentum; this proposal's state is a short-memory relative state across two curve segments computed on index and event-adjusted proxy series. The index-only shadow separates spread-state information from any ETP-NAV trend. D2 tests the claim.
why_information_differs.generic_dow_tue: the shadow is a calendar day-of-week effect; the calendar-clock shadow forces the rule to survive a weekday re-clock and the placebo destroys temporal structure while matching marginals.

ancestry_risk_statement.d2_test_of_claim: pooled ancestry |rho| within the frozen rubric margin against the full pooled inventory INCLUDING every shadow named above; margin recorded per rubric; failure is a D2 VETO, recorded, never argued away.

control_battery_spec.battery_law: the battery must be runnable on the frozen representation with the invalid-null distinction recorded (frozen rubric); the mandatory controls are vetoes, not suggestions (plan section 1 a+b).

index_only_shadow.spec: the identical asymmetry rule with the ETP legs removed from the information set: BOTH spread sides are proxied from the vol INDEX series alone (trailing realized volatility of the VIX close itself, and of a longer lookback variant of the same index series, over the same committed lookbacks), the placement re-clocked onto the ETP buckets -- no ETP price anywhere in the shadow's state. If the ETP-proxy placement is not distinct from its index-proxy re-clock, the ETP legs add nothing and the proposal dies as an index re-clock.

cost_path_control.spec: the rule must survive the measured path-cost ladder on BOTH buckets: measured execution spreads scaled through the committed tier ladder (primary tier at the top), cost once per fill, and the Q-16 roll/decay path component carried explicitly at every tier (SHORT-bucket path formula on the near spread, MID-bucket path formula on the multi-month spread, adverse tails as committed in the frozen cost contract and the P2 gate). A rotation rule pays both sides; kill before selection if either bucket's arm fails the ladder.

calendar_clock_shadow.spec: the same rule re-clocked to a fixed weekday shift (symbolic shift k sessions, frozen at D2/S): a generic_dow_tue detector. A placement that survives the re-clock unchanged is a calendar artefact and dies.

placebo.spec: the asymmetry-state series is time-shuffled with matched marginals and destroyed temporal ordering; the placement induced by the placebo must be indistinguishable from chance. A significant differential placement under the placebo kills the proposal.

control_battery_spec.invalid_null_distinction: an uncomputable state (warmup before either proxy lookback fills, refused tail, missing session) is INVALID and refused fail-closed; it is never coerced to NULL/aligned and never scored as a decision (Q-11).

Declared honestly: a two-bucket rotation pays costs on both sides, so any surviving asymmetry mechanism must be economically LARGE, one-sided and persistent.

falsification_rule.rule: PREREGISTERED KILL (one concrete condition): at D2, if this proposal's asymmetry placement is NOT DISTINCT from its own single-segment marginals -- i.e. the asymmetry state collapses into one of the two bucket placements and the placement is within the frozen rubric ancestry margin of either marginal (or of the lane's sibling spread-state proposal) -- the proposal is killed as NON-NOVEL and recorded as VOL_NG1_REJECT_ALL evidence. Distinctness is the claim; its absence is the kill. No threshold moves after any scored number is seen.
